display.name: Service Health — Single Pane — Refold
display.description: Backed by request_response_latency_seconds (app Summary), nodejs_eventloop_lag_p90_seconds, k8s_container_cpu/memory_limit_utilization, k8s_container_restarts, and k8s_hpa_*. Percentiles come straight from the Summary's quantile sub-metric (no histogram_quantile needed).

display.name: Environment (k8s namespace)
display.description: The Kubernetes namespace Refold is deployed into

display.name: 5xx % — by service
display.description: formula: rate(5xx count) / rate(total count) * 100, grouped by service

filter.expression: k8s_namespace_name IN $namespace AND service_name IN $service AND k8s_pod_name IN $pod AND code REGEXP '^5[0-9]{2}$'
k8s_namespace_name IN $namespace AND service_name IN $service AND k8s_pod_name IN $pod

display.name: 5xx errors / sec (namespace total)
display.description: sum of request rate where code=~'5..' — pair with the 5xx % by service panel for attribution

filter.expression: k8s_namespace_name IN $namespace AND service_name IN $service AND k8s_pod_name IN $pod AND code REGEXP '^5[0-9]{2}$'
k8s.namespace.name IN $namespace AND k8s.pod.name IN $pod

display.name: CPU % of limit — by container (avg)
display.description: k8s_container_cpu_limit_utilization is a pre-computed ratio in [0..1]

filter.expression: k8s.namespace.name IN $namespace AND k8s.pod.name IN $pod

display.name: Event loop lag P90 — by pod (▲ 100 ms = alert)

filter.expression: k8s_namespace_name IN $namespace AND service_name IN $service AND k8s_pod_name IN $pod

display.name: Event loop lag P90 — by service (▲ 100 ms = alert)

filter.expression: k8s_namespace_name IN $namespace AND service_name IN $service AND k8s_pod_name IN $pod

display.name: Max event-loop lag (all services)
display.description: nodejs_eventloop_lag_p90_seconds aggregated with max — cross the 100 ms line and something is blocked

filter.expression: k8s_namespace_name IN $namespace AND service_name IN $service AND k8s_pod_name IN $pod

display.name: HPA replicas — current / desired / max / min
display.description: current == max on a series means the HPA is at ceiling — no headroom for load

filter.expression: k8s.namespace.name IN $namespace
k8s.namespace.name IN $namespace
k8s.namespace.name IN $namespace
k8s.namespace.name IN $namespace

display.name: P95 & P90 latency — by service
display.description: Summary sub-metric filtered by quantile label

filter.expression: k8s_namespace_name IN $namespace AND service_name IN $service AND k8s_pod_name IN $pod AND quantile = '0.95'
k8s_namespace_name IN $namespace AND service_name IN $service AND k8s_pod_name IN $pod AND quantile = '0.9'
k8s.namespace.name IN $namespace AND k8s.pod.name IN $pod

display.name: Memory % of limit — by container (avg)
display.description: k8s_container_memory_limit_utilization is a pre-computed ratio in [0..1]

filter.expression: k8s.namespace.name IN $namespace AND k8s.pod.name IN $pod

display.name: Pod restarts / sec (namespace total)
display.description: rate of k8s_container_restarts across all pods in the namespace

filter.expression: k8s.namespace.name IN $namespace AND k8s.pod.name IN $pod

display.name: Pod restarts over time — by pod
display.description: rate of k8s_container_restarts grouped by pod

filter.expression: k8s.namespace.name IN $namespace AND k8s.pod.name IN $pod

display.name: Slowest APIs — P95 by route (descending)
display.description: quantile=0.95 grouped by route + service; sort by value descending in the legend

filter.expression: k8s_namespace_name IN $namespace AND service_name IN $service AND k8s_pod_name IN $pod AND quantile = '0.95'

display.name: Worst P95 latency (across services)
display.description: Summary quantile=0.95 aggregated with max — if this is high, at least one service is degraded

filter.expression: k8s_namespace_name IN $namespace AND service_name IN $service AND k8s_pod_name IN $pod AND quantile = '0.95'
